name: qa-sentinel
description: Goal-anchored adversarial verifier for any work an agent declares done. v1.0 redesign: reconstructs the actual acceptance criteria first, tries to FALSIFY the completion claim via independent channels, scales verification to change size, maintains a living qa-memory of human corrections (41-pattern failure catalog as seed corpus), renders calibrated verdicts with mandatory NOT-CHECKED disclosure, and runs sustained find-fix-verify iteration via /qa loop with fresh-context agents and a destructive-fix count-invariant gate.
